export.title: Download your data
export.intro: Get a copy of the information campusnotehub holds about your account, as one JSON file you can open in any text editor.

included.account: Your account and profile details, and your privacy settings
included.security: Sign-in methods, two-factor status, sessions and recognised devices
included.social: Who you follow, your followers and follow requests
included.notes: Notes you uploaded, rated or saved
included.mentoring: Your mentor profile or application, bookings and reviews
